author: senommu
description:
A polished SaaS admin UI you can run today — auth, analytics, CRM-style modules, and a custom design system included.

What’s inside

- 🔐  Clerk auth — sign-in, sign-up, OTP, forgot password

- 📊  Dashboard & Analytics — KPIs, charts, world map

- 👥  Workspaces, Customers, Orders

- ✅  Tasks, Calendar, Notes, Chats, Apps

- ⚙️  Full settings — account, theme, team, billing & more

- 🎨  Homlu design kit — light/dark, brand colors, RTL

- ⌘  Command menu, sidebar layouts, polished tables


Stack

React 19 · Vite · TypeScript · TanStack Router/Query · Shadcn UI · Tailwind v4 · Clerk · Recharts · FullCalendar
